example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এককথার মানুষ, যা বলে তাই করে।
এককথা বললে সেটা পালন করতে হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a man of his word; he always keeps his promises.
If you give your word, you must honor it.
note: Refers to a person who stands by their commitments, emphasizing personal honor in Bengali culture.
